intro: Team Phantom is a competitive Rocket League esports organization. We run three official esports teams, our own 2v2 championship series (TPCS), and a community for players of every rank.
tpcs: TPCS is our Rocket League 2v2 franchise championship series, with the Uprising, Ascent and Eclipse leagues.
community: Our community welcomes every rank, with coaching, teammates and events. Membership does not guarantee an esports roster spot.
recruit: Choose esports tryouts, TPCS registration or community membership.
